summary: Planned marketing to support the raise. Agreed two annual sector outlooks, three Fund II case studies and a quarterly LP letter. Richard's speaking programme is pending and campaign measurement was put off.

discussion.keyPoints: Richard and Natalie agreed the specialist positioning needs visible sector research behind it.
Natalie proposed the domiciliary care platform, the nursery group and the specialist schools business as the strongest Fund II stories.
Richard is willing to speak but is worried about time away from deals during the raise.

recommendations.recommendation: Publish two annual outlooks, one on UK healthcare services and one on UK education.
Produce three Fund II case studies: the domiciliary care platform, the nursery group and the specialist schools business.
Send a quarterly LP letter combining portfolio news with one sector insight.
Richard to speak at 3 healthcare or education industry events in 2027.
Track data room visits and meeting requests against each marketing piece.
